notes: seed.sql defines 94 permissions (not 154): 91 in seed.sql plus 3 inserted by schema.sql. Counted by loading schema.sql + seed.sql into a private MariaDB.
Role permission lists are the FINAL state after every grant/revoke in seed.sql (computed from the loaded DB).
Path params use {name} (PHP); Node uses :name with the same names.
specific_test_files: tests that name the route path or call the controller action directly; sweep tests (RouteMatrix, UngatedRoutes, NavLinks) are listed in sweep_coverage instead.
Form fields come from static parsing of PHP views; fields rendered by helpers (Csrf, EditFingerprint) are not listed.

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Full system access, including user/role administration and audit log.

roles.name: Managing Director
roles.description: Full business authority: approvals, all order/document actions, reporting.

roles.name: Executive Director
roles.description: Full business authority: approvals, all order/document actions, reporting.

roles.name: Export Executive
roles.description: Day-to-day order handling, quotations through order confirmation, document generation.

roles.name: Accounts Executive
roles.description: Payment tracking, balance follow-up, financial reporting.

roles.name: Logistics Executive
roles.description: Packing, freight, BL instruction, shipping-stage documents.

roles.name: Viewer / Auditor
roles.description: Read-only access to reports, audit trail, and the Orders/Clients modules.

roles.name: CA / Chartered Accountant
roles.description: External or in-house Chartered Accountant — view-only access to the CA/Accounting module for statutory bookkeeping. No order-management access.

roles.name: System Administrator
roles.description: Administration — users, settings and templates; no business money

roles.name: Order Coordinator
roles.description: Order Desk — status of every order, no prices

roles.name: Investor (view only)
roles.description: Dashboards and reports across all divisions; no editing (D-257).

roles.name: Super Admin
roles.mechanism: users.is_super_admin=1 (+ super_admin_delegations); bypasses every permission check; only actor allowed on SuperAdminOnly routes

roles.name: Client (client portal)
roles.mechanism: ClientAuth (client_logins, provisioned when the Stage 3 advance clears); routes under /client/*; staff can impersonate with impersonate_client when client_impersonation_enabled and the client allows it

roles.name: Associate (associate portal)
roles.mechanism: AssociateAuth (associates + e-mailed login code); routes under /associate/*

roles.name: Public / token holder
roles.mechanism: no sign-in; one-use or long-lived tokens: /quotation-details, /invite/{token}, /pi-details/{token}, /buyer-action/{token}, /payment-action/{token}, /supplier-action/{token}, /vendor-details/{token}, /associate-register/{token}, password reset/set links

roles.name: Incentive roles (not access roles)
roles.mechanism: incentive_roles table — share of the team incentive pool; Sales Manager is one of these, not a login role

roles.name: Designation preview ("Preview as") / department membership
roles.mechanism: user_department_memberships + ActiveDepartmentService::effectiveRoleId — a person signed in "as" a department designation gets that designation's role; /choose-department, /switch-department, /preview/exit

permissions.name: Export database structure/data
permissions.description: Download a full structure-only and data-only dump of the live database, to migrate all historical records into a fresh reinstall. Kept separate from manage_company_settings since it can expose every record, including staff password hashes.

permissions.name: Delete assets
permissions.description: Permanently remove a superseded (inactive) logo/signature/seal/watermark upload. The currently active asset for a type can never be deleted this way — replace it first.

permissions.name: Manage approval limits
permissions.description: Change a designation's purchase approval limit or make it a 'director' (no limit). Never on a designation one holds oneself. QA Round 8, R8-N10.

permissions.name: Manage assets
permissions.description: Upload/replace logo, signature, seal, watermark.

permissions.name: Manage company settings
permissions.description: Edit company_settings key-value configuration.

permissions.name: Manage divisions
permissions.description: Admin > Divisions: modules, number formats, division settings and activating a planned division. D-257.

permissions.name: Manage email templates
permissions.description: Add or edit email templates used when composing a send (never delete — every past send keeps its own frozen copy in the email log regardless).

permissions.name: Manage field protection
permissions.description: Request or approve locking/unlocking a protected field (company setting, T&C clause, or payment preset). Approving your own request is blocked — a different privileged user must confirm.

permissions.name: Manage roles & permissions
permissions.description: Edit role/user permission matrix.

permissions.name: Manage sample data
permissions.description: Load/clear the Sample Data Playground (test clients/orders only — never real data).

permissions.name: Manage signatories & designations
permissions.description: Manage the designations list, mark a user as signatory-eligible, upload their signature/designation-seal images, and set the global and per-document-type default signatory.

permissions.name: Task due days
permissions.description: Set the standard and escalation days of each kind of department task. D-214 phase 4.

permissions.name: Manage users
permissions.description: Create/edit/deactivate user accounts and assign roles.

permissions.name: See all divisions
permissions.description: Company level: see every division's orders, clients and reports, and pick one division or "All divisions" in the header (the picker shows only when two or more divisions are active). D-257.

permissions.name: View audit log
permissions.description: View the immutable system audit trail.

permissions.name: Manage agreements
permissions.description: Add, edit, renew and terminate agreements with clients, suppliers, logistics partners, associates and staff; sees staff NDAs; gets the expiry reminders

permissions.name: View agreements
permissions.description: See the agreements register and download signed copies (not staff agreements)

permissions.name: Manage associates
permissions.description: Associate register, agreements, rates, invitations, client links and their changes, portal access

permissions.name: Associate bank & tax details
permissions.description: See associates' full bank details and verify bank changes (two people)

permissions.name: View associates
permissions.description: See which client was introduced by which associate (no amounts, bank details or agreements)

permissions.name: Override a financial year lock
permissions.description: Push through a single CA entry even while its financial year is locked — for a genuine backdated correction, never routine use. Every use is logged. Kept separate from ca_module_manage, which can reopen a year outright for everyone.

permissions.name: Manage internal CA financial annexure
permissions.description: Toggle the internal-only CA Financial Annexure (govt export benefits + expenses) for an order and generate it. Not auto-granted to Accounts Executive/CA roles — only Admin/MD/ED and Super Admin get it by default.

permissions.name: Manage CA / Accounting integrations
permissions.description: Trigger a Zoho Books sync and view its log, and lock/unlock a financial year for CA data entry — kept separate from ca_module_view since these are administrative actions with a wider blast radius than routine data entry, not just reading the register.

permissions.name: View CA / Accounting module
permissions.description: View the CA/Accounting module (independent of the order-pipeline system) — the INR settlement register and, as later phases land, revenue/expense/reconciliation reports.

permissions.name: Delete INR actual settlement amounts
permissions.description: Remove a recorded INR actual amount (e.g. to correct a mis-entry) — kept separate from edit since this is a destructive correction, not routine data entry.

permissions.name: Add/edit INR actual settlement amounts
permissions.description: Record or correct the actual INR amount credited to the bank for a cleared advance/balance/freight payment.

permissions.name: View INR actual settlement amounts
permissions.description: See the actual INR amount credited to the bank for a cleared advance/balance/freight payment.

permissions.name: Manage order financials
permissions.description: View/add/edit an order's export benefit claims, other costs, and its profitability summary. Stricter than ca_module_view/inr_actual_edit: not auto-granted to Accounts/CA, only Admin/MD/ED and Super Admin by default.

permissions.name: View & download CAFIN
permissions.description: See and download the internal CA Financial Annexure (CAFIN): the CAFIN box on the order page and CAFIN in document lists. Never reaches the client. Grant or remove per role or per person (e.g. a CA during an audit).

permissions.name: Browse product catalog
permissions.description: Browse the full product catalog list, not just search results.

permissions.name: Manage compliance task types
permissions.description: Add or deactivate compliance task types (ECGC Cover, Pre-Shipment Inspection, etc.). Does not grant the order-page checklist itself - that uses close_orders. Same tier as manage_hs_codes/manage_logistics_partners: Admin/MD/ED and Super Admin only.

permissions.name: Manage dropdown option lists
permissions.description: Add, edit, and deactivate the admin-editable option lists used across the app (Container Type, Certificate of Origin Type, etc. — see dropdown_options.list_key). Same tier as manage_hs_codes/manage_logistics_partners: Admin/MD/ED and Super Admin only.

permissions.name: Manage HS code master list
permissions.description: Add, edit, and deactivate HS codes in the master list order creation picks from — kept separate from ordinary order-entry access so a new code always goes through a privileged person first.

permissions.name: Manage logistics partners
permissions.description: Add, edit, and deactivate CHA and transportation partners in the directory order staff pick contacts from. Same tier as manage_hs_codes: Admin/MD/ED and Super Admin only by default.

permissions.name: Manage payment presets
permissions.description: Create, edit, deactivate payment presets (advance/balance %, balance-trigger wording). Drives every order's payment calc. Same tier as manage_logistics_partners. Existing presets ship protected — unlock via Field Protection first.

permissions.name: Manage ports
permissions.description: Add, edit, and deactivate the Port of Loading / Port of Discharge options offered on the New Order form. Same tier as manage_hs_codes/manage_logistics_partners: Admin/MD/ED and Super Admin only.

permissions.name: Manage pricing
permissions.description: Change the pricing settings, a product's pricing overrides, the associate commission levels and ladder, and an associate's commission level. D-245: MD only.

permissions.name: Manage product catalog
permissions.description: Create, edit, and delete products, suppliers, images, and misc charges.

permissions.name: Manage a product's specifications
permissions.description: Change one product's specifications: hide a specification or option, change an option's value, add options or specifications for that product only, reset to the category. D-255: privileged roles (Admin, MD to start).

permissions.name: Manage suppliers
permissions.description: Add, edit, deactivate and delete suppliers (and their types and factory addresses) in the Suppliers directory the Supplier PO picks from. Same tier as manage_logistics_partners: Admin/MD/ED and Super Admin only by default.

permissions.name: Record supplier / market prices
permissions.description: Record supplier and market prices for products (dated, valid until, history) and mark the one used for pricing. Shows no selling prices, margins or floors. D-245: Procurement.

permissions.name: See the full price build-up
permissions.description: See a product's cost, margin, minimum price, team-incentive reserve, every floor and quote price, and the pricing settings. D-245: MD, ED. Never reaches the client.

permissions.name: View product catalog
permissions.description: Search and view individual products in the internal product catalog.

permissions.name: View product pricing
permissions.description: See product pricing, supplier list, and misc charges.

permissions.name: Log in as a client
permissions.description: Start a staff-initiated client-portal session for a client who can't use the portal themselves. Requires client_impersonation_enabled (global) and the client's own allow_staff_impersonation flag both on. Every use is logged.

permissions.name: View clients (read-only)
permissions.description: See the Clients list and a client's detail page without being able to create, edit, or act on it. Anyone holding manage_orders already has this implicitly — this permission exists only for a view-only tier that holds no manage_orders.

permissions.name: View full client email
permissions.description: See a client's full email address (vs a masked view).

permissions.name: Approve documents
permissions.description: Approve/release a generated document to the buyer.

permissions.name: Approve email send (Level 2)
permissions.description: Level-2 approval for a deferred client email before it actually sends (Section 10 — Email & Deferred Send System).

permissions.name: Cross-verify documents
permissions.description: Add an independent pass/fail quality check on any generated document — separate from the formal reviewer sign-off.

permissions.name: Download PDF
permissions.description: Download a generated PDF document.

permissions.name: Override locked data
permissions.description: Edit a field that is normally locked after stage sign-off.

permissions.name: Generate compliance documents
permissions.description: Generate the COO Prep Sheet (for the Certificate of Origin application) without the general Generate documents permission. D-226: Export Compliance.

permissions.name: Generate documents
permissions.description: Generate QT/PI/OC/PL/CI/etc. for an order.

permissions.name: Manage team incentives
permissions.description: See and change the incentive settings, each order's incentive and profit basis, the associate register and every payout. Owner decision 2026-10-30: you and the MD only.

permissions.name: Pay incentives
permissions.description: See the incentive payouts list (person, order, amount) and record payments. No profit, no settings, cannot change amounts.

permissions.name: View own incentives
permissions.description: See your own incentive amounts once the buyer has fully paid.

permissions.name: See buyer payments
permissions.description: What the buyer has paid and still owes: the payment snapshot, the remittances and their screenshots. D-214: Sales, Finance, management, auditors, CA.

permissions.name: See logistics costs
permissions.description: CHA, transport and packing costs in the catalogue, freight rates, and logistics bills and their scans. D-214: Logistics, Finance, management, auditors, CA.

permissions.name: See purchase prices
permissions.description: Supplier PO values, factory and supplier costs in the catalogue, supplier bills and their scans, and the Supplier PO document. D-214: Procurement, Finance, management, auditors, CA.

permissions.name: See selling prices
permissions.description: Unit prices, FOB and order values, and the sales documents that carry them (QT, PI, OC, CI, AMD, Debit Note). D-214: Sales, Finance, management, auditors, CA.

permissions.name: Approve payment terms
permissions.description: Approve an order's payment terms when its preset is marked "Requires MD approval" — needed before the Quotation can be generated or sent. Default: Admin, MD, ED.

permissions.name: Approve short payment
permissions.description: Approve a short payment — clear a buyer payment that is less than due, with a written reason

permissions.name: Assign department owners
permissions.description: Choose who in a department owns an order for that department (a manager for their own department; MD/ED and Admin for any). D-214 phase 4.

permissions.name: Manage order assignees
permissions.description: Add or remove which staff are assigned to an order (order_assignees). Visibility-only control — never affects stage-gate or payment/shipping permissions.

permissions.name: Clear a buyer payment
permissions.description: Confirm a buyer payment actually landed in the bank, unlocking the next stage gate — split out of manage_payments so the person who records a payment is never also the one who confirms it. Accounts/Admin/MD/ED only by default.

permissions.name: Close or mark an order lost
permissions.description: Close a fully-despatched order or mark one lost — QA-5 RBAC-04: split out of manage_orders so an Accounts-only user can no longer close an order.

permissions.name: Edit an order after confirmation
permissions.description: Edit order details or product rows once Order Confirmation has been issued (Stage 4+) — a reason is required and every use is logged. Before Stage 4, manage_orders alone is enough.

permissions.name: Manage complaints
permissions.description: View complaints, acknowledge/resolve them, and log one on a client's behalf. Not auto-inherited from manage_orders — only Admin/MD/ED and Super Admin get it by default, same tier as manage_disputes.

permissions.name: Compliance checklist
permissions.description: Work the order's compliance checklist (ECGC cover, inspection, fumigation, phytosanitary, due diligence …). D-226: Export Compliance, and everyone who could already do it through Close orders.

permissions.name: Manage disputes
permissions.description: View/raise/update a dispute's status, attach evidence, and enable/disable the client-facing dispute button. Not auto-inherited from manage_orders — only Admin/MD/ED and Super Admin get it by default.

permissions.name: File export benefit claims
permissions.description: Answer which export benefit schemes an order is eligible for and file the claims (scheme, reference no., amount claimed, date). Recording the money received stays with Manage order financials. D-226: Export Compliance.

permissions.name: Add logistics partner bills
permissions.description: Add a CHA, transport or freight-forwarder bill to an order and remove one that has no payment on it. Paying it needs Manage supplier payments.

permissions.name: Manage orders
permissions.description: Create/edit orders and advance them through stage gates.

permissions.name: Manage order payments
permissions.description: Record and clear an order's advance/balance payment (Stages 3 and 8) — QA-5 RBAC-03/04: split out of manage_orders so a Logistics-only user can no longer mark a buyer payment as cleared; kept with Accounts, who already owns payment tracking.

permissions.name: Manage shipping & freight
permissions.description: Record freight terms/payment and packing/BL/shipping actions (Stages 6-7 and 9) — QA-5 RBAC-04: split out of manage_orders so an Accounts-only user can no longer record a BL.

permissions.name: Manage supplier payments
permissions.description: Mark a supplier payment as paid, and see the Outgoing (Supplier) side of Today's Payments — split out of manage_order_financials so Accounts can confirm supplier payments without the broader financials/profitability access.

permissions.name: Supplier PO and production
permissions.description: Create and confirm the Supplier PO and record production status (steps 7a-7d). D-214: Procurement, not Sales.

permissions.name: Override buyer Order Confirmation acknowledgment
permissions.description: Record a buyer's OC acknowledgment manually (e.g. an email reply). Only consulted when oc_ack_override_restricted is on; off by default, where manage_orders alone is enough.

permissions.name: Override shipment gates
permissions.description: Override shipment gates — release the BL step with a written reason when the pre-shipment balance or the inspection is not cleared

permissions.name: Respond to complaints
permissions.description: Post a reply in a complaint's conversation thread — kept separate from manage_complaints so sales roles can answer without also managing its status, same split as respond_to_disputes.

permissions.name: Respond to disputes
permissions.description: Post a reply in a dispute's reply thread — kept separate from manage_disputes so sales roles can answer without also managing dispute status or the button.

permissions.name: Mark an order fully settled
permissions.description: Mark an order fully settled once every rupee is in and out. D-214: Finance.

permissions.name: Attach documents to an order
permissions.description: Attach government and agency documents (ECGC policy, Certificate of Origin, phytosanitary / fumigation / inspection certificates, eBRC …) to an order in Step 14, without Manage orders. D-226: Export Compliance.

permissions.name: View all orders regardless of assignment
permissions.description: See every order in the Orders list, Kanban board, and order detail page, not just ones assigned to you. Oversight roles only.

permissions.name: View archived orders
permissions.description: See orders that have been archived out of the default listing. Archiving never deletes anything — this only gates who can look an archived order up.

permissions.name: View orders (read-only)
permissions.description: See the Orders list and an order's detail page without being able to create, edit, or act on it. Anyone holding manage_orders already has this implicitly — this permission exists only for a view-only tier that holds no manage_orders.

permissions.name: Approve purchases above a limit
permissions.description: Approve an award above the awarding designation's approval limit (up to this designation's own limit; no limit = any amount). D-214: Procurement Manager / Director, MD/ED.

permissions.name: Work purchase requirements
permissions.description: Record supplier quotes, compare and award, follow production, record receipt and the quality check. D-214: Procurement.

permissions.name: Raise purchase requirements
permissions.description: Ask Procurement for what an order needs (product, quantity, needed by) — no prices. D-214: Sales, management.

permissions.name: Manage saved reports
permissions.description: Create/edit/delete saved report definitions.

permissions.name: Management cockpit
permissions.description: Open, overdue and escalated work per department, orders by stage, supplier delays and overdue buyer payments — counts and status only. D-214 phase 4.

permissions.name: View reports
permissions.description: Run and view reports and dashboards.

permissions.name: View staff productivity reports
permissions.description: View the Staff Productivity report (documents generated and audit-log activity per user) — kept separate from view_reports since it shows individual staff activity, not just business data.

e2e 01-critical-path walks a CIF order through all 9 gates

export.gate_action: QT sent (mail on) or approved (mail off) — ReviewWorkflowService/EmailDispatchService
Advance cleared: POST /orders/{id}/payment/advance/clear (cash) or LC confirmed usable (LC preset); provisions client portal
OC acknowledged: POST /orders/{id}/oc-acknowledgment, /client/orders/{id}/acknowledge-oc, /buyer-action/{token}/acknowledge-oc, or cron auto_confirm_oc_acknowledgments after oc_ack_auto_confirm_hours
Supplier PO signed: POST /orders/{id}/supplier-po/signed (or /supplier-action/{token}/acknowledgment then confirm); FOB auto-skips Stage 6
BL issued: POST /orders/{id}/bl-issued (shipment gates: pre-shipment balance, inspection; override_shipment_gates)
Balance cleared: POST /orders/{id}/payment/balance/clear (incl. short-payment path approve_short_payment)

stages.domestic_gates: DomesticOrderService::blockers — lines; DQT generated; buyer GSTIN + DOC; supplier PO ref (or IMP stock); dispatch date/vehicle, e-way bill above dom_eway_threshold_inr, GTI + DCH; …; advance via POST /domestic/orders/{id}/advance
stages.import_gates: ImportService::blockers — lines + import PO; BL; customs clearance (BoE, rate, CHA, date); supplier fully paid; IGST credit date
stages.merchant_gates: MerchantTradeService::blockers — lines, BL, both legs settled, RBI time limits (mtt_max_months_total, mtt_max_outlay_months, mtt_advance_limit_usd)
